title: Ex-Republican Strategist Warns Democrats Against ‘Picking Pointless Fights’ Against Each Other
author: John Harwood
content:
As US President Donald Trump continues to grow more and more divisive, many
former Republicans continue to find themselves searching for a new political
home.

In this Substack Live, **John Harwood** speaks with ex-Republican and [The
Bulwark's](https://www.thebulwark.com/) editor-at-large**Bill Kristol** about
the broadening political opposition to Trump in the run-up to the 2026 midterm
elections.

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

Kristol tells Harwood that while he thinks Democrats will have victory in the
midterms,** "I don't think that crushes the MAGA movement. I think it stalls
it."**

The conversation between Harwood and Kristol was live on
[Zeteo.com](http://zeteo.com/) and the Substack app, and both took questions
from subscribers in the live audience.
